text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —Surely, this must be a dream.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"However, it is neither something that 
fades, nor something that pales, nor 
something that should ever be let go."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My feelings will truly live on and breathe 
within this world—

Fine Motion had safely returned, and on a 
day when she was continuing the 
continuation of those wonderful three 
years—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! Hey, over here, over here!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, were you surprised? I decided to lie 
in ambush for you♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you have some time right now? 
There's a casual gathering going on, so 
won't you come with me?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"—Allow me to introduce him. This is my 
Trainer from the academy."

text_block_list.name: Ambassador of Ireland
text_block_list.text: Nice to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The ambassador here is a university friend 
of my father's, so he has looked out for 
me ever since I was very young...

text_block_list.name: Ambassador of Ireland
text_block_list.text:
"Still, whenever I used to visit, you were 
always running around all over the 
place... and now you've grown into such a 
respectable person."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I still run about full of energy♪ It 
is all thanks to the Ambassador and 
everyone else.

Then it dawned on me. The person before me 
was likely the one who recommended Fine 
Motion as a goodwill ambassador.

text_block_list.name: Ambassador of Ireland
text_block_list.text:
No, I merely recommended the most suitable 
person for a necessary post. Your father 
was in agreement as well.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ! My father too...?

text_block_list.name: Ambassador of Ireland
text_block_list.text:
Yes. You must have had an opportunity to 
learn just how many people in Japan wished 
for you to take on that role.

text_block_list.name: Ambassador of Ireland
text_block_list.text:
Having been in this country myself, I have 
heard much— far too much, in fact—of your 
reputation, and thus recommended you based 
on that proven track record.

text_block_list.name: Ambassador of Ireland
text_block_list.text:
"The President and Prime Minister of 
Ireland both agreed that you are worthy of 
being an ambassador. It seems word of your 
great success reached all the way back 
home."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much. Truly—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Chuckling at the memory!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I noticed that at the start of the party, 
you kept looking all over the place, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Huh? It was a pretty relaxed atmosphere, 
wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
There were so many people I wanted to 
introduce you to, and I thought it would 
be a great chance to do so without things 
being too formal, but...
choice_data_list: I can really tell just how loved you are.
I could tell how much you're loved.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“You're right. It looks like I really am 
loved.”

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Well, given my position, you know. It's 
less about me and more...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I was just vaguely thinking, "Oh, she must 
mean Fine Motion~"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“Turns out that wasn't true at all, was 
it? Everyone had my best interests in 
mind.”

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That makes me so happy. I really am the 
luckiest...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe it's because I found my very own 
four-leaf clover of good luck?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"It's because of you, Trainer. Meeting you 
changed so many things."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Because you found the real me... the me 
who truly wished to run. And because of 
that, I became so much happier.
choice_data_list: I appreciate it, but that's not quite it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —You're finally back! You're late, Fine!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I've been waiting for you~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... Huh, did I make some kind of 
promise?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? But didn't we just talk about 
running together!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're both here, let's run 
together!" Fine said...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, was that today?! It completely 
slipped my mind~!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —That's way too careless.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hard to believe you manage your official 
duties with that attitude, your Royal 
Highness.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Even Shakur...! You came for me, didn't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, no reason to pass up a chance to 
collect this much data.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The others have gathered at the track too. 
...Good grief, just how many people did 
you invite?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That's how it is. Hurry up and get ready.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I can see a different path now. ...Let's 
enjoy this, Fine?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...That was such a surprise~. I know we 
promised, but I never expected so many 
people to show up!"

All the girls gathered here today are 
captivated by Fine Motion's running— and 
by the sheer power she possesses within 
herself.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That's the best compliment ever♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, let us go! —To where I 
belong!"
